ItiApplication.title: ITI Manufacturing Hiring Application
ItiApplication.description: Candidate registration for the 1,500+ Chennai Industry Hiring + 3-Year Diploma in Manufacturing Engineering programme on Recruits.org.in.

applicationRef.description: Unique human-readable application reference code (e.g. REC-ITI-2026-4821).

fullName.description: Candidate full name as per Aadhaar or academic certificate.

aadhaarNumber.description: 12-digit Indian Aadhaar number stored with strict admin-only read isolation.

aadhaarMasked.description: Masked Aadhaar display string showing only the last 4 digits.

qualification.description: Highest eligible qualification for the 3-Year Manufacturing Diploma + Hiring programme.

itiTrade.description: ITI trade specialization (e.g. Fitter, Electrician, Welder) or empty string for 10th/12th candidates.

collegeName.description: Optional ITI college or school name.

consentAccepted.description: Explicit voluntary consent from the candidate for hiring verification and contact.

programSlug.description: Canonical slug identifying the Chennai Manufacturing Engineering Diploma + Hiring drive.

status.description: Hiring pipeline stage managed exclusively by verified Recruits.org.in admins.

whatsappShared.description: Whether the candidate's ITI certificate has been received via WhatsApp (+91 93379 52401).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of initial student registration (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest admin status update.

AdminUser.title: Admin Access Record
AdminUser.description: Trusted administrator account allowed to review ITI Manufacturing Hiring leads.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/itiApplications/{applicationId}.description: Permanent cloud repository of student registrations for the 1,500+ Chennai ITI Manufacturing Hiring + 3-Year Diploma drive. Strictly create-only for candidates; read/list/update/delete restricted exclusively to verified Recruits.org.in admins.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Verified admin registry managed by the bootstrapped owner (recruit.org.contact@gmail.com).
